_source: Pass 50 of plans/evil-mode-rework/redesign-50 (pages jobs, live, calling, market, cargo, gymplan, gymtalk, gear, power, snap, phase, teamup, crewin, legend). Director 2026-11-21: give the mockups' pages simple real rules. Numbers are balance: tune here.

lines: “{target} has one night guard. He naps at two.”
“I've watched {target} for a week, Boss. We can do it.”
board.empty: Nothing on the board right now. Try the Region Map.

events: A staff member looks up from the desk. {who} freezes behind the shelves.
A Growlithe on a chain lifts its head. {who} holds their breath.
Footsteps on the stairs. {who} is caught between two doors.
A light comes on in the back room. {who} drops flat.
live.smokeLine: A puff of smoke and {who} is gone. Nothing taken, nobody saw a face.

calling.motto: We took what we came for. We will be back.
lines: “Leave a card? Feels like bragging, Boss. I like it.”
calling.left: The card goes on the counter. {district} will talk about {team} tomorrow.
calling.notNow: There's no job to sign right now.

market.line: “Dirty money spends just fine in here, friend.”
market.closed: The Black Market opens in the evening, and you need a Fence or a Black Market contact.

items.name: Smoke Ball
items.about: A clean escape from the Hero

items.name: Shell Bell
items.about: Heals a bit on each hit

lines: “Not the Houndour, Boss. It'll bark at the first conductor it sees.”
“Light load, easy ride. Heavy load, heavy pay.”
check: the conductor is looking at every bag

plan.beat: “Walk in the front door and beat {leader}. A badge, and the town learns our name.”
plan.buy: “Money talks. Buy the building and {leader} works for us.”
plan.break: “Every trainer, then {leader}, no rest. We take the whole Gym.”
plan.blackmail: “Everyone has a secret. Find {leader}'s and they'll do as we say.”
plan.convert: “Beat {leader} first. Then we talk them into joining us.”

talk.beat: You want my Gym? Then show me you can hold it.
talk.buy: Money. Of course it's money. Name your price, then.
talk.break: I hear your people outside. You'd tear this place apart?
talk.blackmail: You've been asking questions about me. What do you want?
talk.convert: You fight well. Why would someone like you work in the shadows?

ask.buy: Take the money and step aside
ask.blackmail: Step aside, or the town hears your secret
ask.convert: Join us, and keep your title
